limitations: Consensus approves only this frozen Proposed ADR bundle; it does not accept any ADR, authorize implementation, or authorize deployment.

The branch changes no vendored contract code. Exact fork implementation, audit/review, reproducible Wasm, differential tests, testnet canaries, successor readiness, staffing, and every release gate in the ADRs remain mandatory.
